subtopic: Trump Account Investment Options and Contributions
source_evidence: All contributions will be invested in low cost mutual funds or ETFs that track broad U.S. equity indices (such as the S&P 500).
question: Misconception: Trump Account contributions can be invested in any kind of asset the account holder chooses.
answer: The source describes contributions as being invested in low-cost mutual funds or ETFs that track broad U.S. equity indices, such as the S&P 500. It does not describe an unrestricted investment menu.
